title: Microsoft Purview: Rights Management connector moves to certificate-based authentication
summary: The briefing passes: its roadmap dates, existing connector requirements and administrator command are supported. It distinguishes the planned certificate authentication from today's documented setup and appropriately leaves the new configuration and migration details unresolved.
